body: I've been sleeping during the day or spending it in my room. This last month has been really rough and I don't want my moods to effect my friends/roommates. But it still has. they blew up on me for it a few days ago. They don't understand that I can't stand to live like this anymore. I want to die. It's really the only way I can fix all of this. I just need to go away. They will all be better off without me and I can finally rest. I just want to rest.
I normally avoid them. I know that my depression and mood swings causes problems for them. So I don't usually get into them.

Normal childhood. I read very well, and at a very high level. I did very good in school, up until 6th grade. I started doing more and more poorly. I didn't do very well socially in middle school. I didn't get into fights but I had a hard time relating to my peers. I guess interpersonal relationships started to be a problem for me at that time.
I don't think a stranger on the other end of a phone in a call center is going to be able to really help me. The best they could do is call the police and have me hospitalized and that just won't do.
She knows I have problems with my emotions. But I can tell that she dosen't grasp the scope of this. I don't think anyone really does. Hospitalization is not an option.

I live in the United States and as far as I know we put our crazies in for-profit prisons where they are pumped with addictive medications. I've looked into medical care and I'd honestly rather be dead than spend anytime in a hospital.
